agreements: D0 must remain a local deterministic CPU reference-and-falsifier stage; it cannot execute a model or provider call, load model weights for inference, train or read a LoRA, use a GPU or remote service, run a scientific cell, or make a scientific claim.

The full THINK--DREAM--SLEEP--per-life-memory architecture and later on-policy feedback edge remain represented but dormant, with proposal formation, public-evidence support, deterministic compilation, retrieval/composition, parametric transport, and action feedback receiving distinct credit.

Counterfactual twins, exact no-lifetime control, authentic source-derived memory controls, append-only support, immutable snapshots, one-atom reader returns, deterministic one-edge compilation, pair-level estimation, failure-as-zero, resource ledgers, and fail-closed authority are the right classes of safeguards for a future exact bundle.

A green D0 can establish only conformance of a reference instrument and readiness to request new authority; scripted fixtures cannot establish that a future model DREAM discovers structure, THINK uses memory constructively, or a LoRA transports action value.

PCFL-13 is a fixed-deck finite mechanism assay with only 13 reusable mappings and an imposed 8192-token working budget; it cannot establish scaling, continual or online learning, recurrence superiority, A4 revision, the action--experience flywheel, external validity, or autonomous causal discovery.

All eleven context-file hashes and the raw proposal, interpretation, and critique bindings are current, but exact hash binding of the files that exist does not supply the material schemas, instances, algorithms, or authority limits that are absent.

disagreements.issue: Whether ratification of v1 would bind an exact D0 implementation scope, or instead let implementers choose material benchmark and authority bytes after approval.

positions.position: The prose component boundary, visibility matrix, AT01 hash review, AT02 capability scan, and later D1 review are sufficient to authorize D0 construction while keeping science dormant.

positions.actor: systems and benchmark interpreters plus adversarial critique
positions.position: The missing source/test/command allowlist, transitive capability classes, full CPU budget, exact schemas and golden bytes, tokenizer/renderer cut fixtures, and frozen instance/split manifests are material pre-implementation choices, so v1 is not an exact D0 authority artifact.

resolution.rationale: The critique position controls. AT01 and AT02 can audit bytes only after those bytes have been selected; they cannot convert post-ratification design choices into previously ratified scope. AT02--AT16 being mostly labeled required before GPU does not prevent those choices from being embedded during D0. Exact D0 implementation authority therefore cannot be released from v1.
resolution.selected_position: Require a successor exact D0 bundle before any implementation.
resolution.required_change: Create a v2 change that hash-binds every permitted D0 source and test path, command and entry point, transitive dependency/capability class, output artifact, wall-time/core/memory/process/energy ceiling and failure disposition; every canonical schema and representative serialized golden byte string; NFC-before-JCS and copy-origin semantics; exact renderer and tokenizer revision/hash with complete-event token-cut vectors; protocol-hash and RNG derivation; the 64 CPU pair/target/rejection manifests and all DEV/calibration/confirmation/reserve seed and ordering manifests. Make every test that fixes a material design choice a pre-implementation design-binding requirement, then repeat fresh interpretation, critique, adjudication, and exact-byte human ratification.

disagreements.issue: Whether the compiler and S-bind envelope contain four views per atom or six.

positions.actor: graph delta, note 47 section 7, and AT10
positions.position: Every atom emits exactly four one-edge views: forward completion, reverse completion, incident-edge recall, and one-memory statement.

positions.actor: note 47 section 10 and inherited note 44 wording
positions.position: S-bind preserves six view counts, implying a six-view corpus envelope.

resolution.rationale: Four views is the coherent intended position because it is repeated in the executable graph, SLEEP loop, and AT10, but consensus cannot silently rewrite the contradictory hash-bound context. Corpus cardinality affects intervention validity, token lengths, candidate exposure, training envelopes, and resource accounting.
resolution.selected_position: Exactly four one-edge views per canonical atom.
resolution.required_change: In v2, replace every stale six-view clause with the same four named views and bind that cardinality across SLEEP, S-bind, candidate generation, corpus and resource manifests, and golden fixtures before implementation.

disagreements.issue: Whether Bayes-N and the exact-memory controller are uniquely defined and support the claimed no-lifetime and authentic-memory conclusions.

positions.position: A uniform accepted-deck prior, full-family/quotient agreement, and one exact authentic-memory controller suffice to establish exact no-lifetime headroom and memory necessity.

The accepted-item posterior and empirical quantile are unspecified, and hidden-world solvability, unrestricted eligible-atom information, and bounded authentic source-derived one-atom access are distinct controllers with distinct conclusions.

resolution.rationale: Full-versus-quotient equivalence validates two implementations only after the target-conditioned posterior is fixed; it cannot identify the correct posterior. Likewise, a controller with hidden mappings or direct graph access cannot establish usability through the declared reader. The controls must be separated before the AT05/AT06 thresholds have a stable meaning.
resolution.selected_position: Bind the accepted-visible-item Bayes posterior and three separately named memory oracles/controllers.
resolution.required_change: V2 must enumerate the posterior induced by visible target bytes, target construction, and joint-twin acceptance; exclude unobserved rejection metadata; specify exact rational zero-mass/degenerate handling and the 64-pair 90th-percentile convention; and bind independent golden calculations. Register separately a hidden-world solvability oracle, a complete causally eligible atom-set information ceiling, and an authentic source-derived controller operating only through the exact generic one-atom reader with fixed query, repeat, workspace, resolver-operation, and action budgets. Restrict lifetime-memory usability claims to the last controller.

disagreements.issue: Whether generic anchor-only reads can reach all required A2/A3 premises without a target-bearing scaffold and whether every paired item hides twin identity before memory use.

positions.position: A target-blind catalog, copy-only anchors, one-atom returns, collision twins, bounded workspace, and scripted causal traces adequately specify the constructive channel.

Incident ordering, repeated-FOUND/dedup/discard behavior, the fresh-handle-to-family bridge, numeric operation caps, exhaustive premise reachability, and complete per-target input collisions are missing, so the reader or target constructor may carry the answer.

resolution.rationale: Hand-authored favorable traces cannot prove all accepted targets are solvable through the primary generic interface. Initial/source-byte collision also does not prove collision of the exact goal, state, workspace, budgets, prompt input, reader snapshot, catalog behavior, serialization, and timing class for a target pair whose correct assignments differ.
resolution.selected_position: Require exhaustive generic-interface reachability and complete pre-action target-pair collisions.
resolution.required_change: V2 must bind generic incident ordering, repeat advancement, deduplication, discarded-slot behavior, query membership, the public target-handle to reusable-family-atom bridge, and exact THINK/DREAM query and operation caps. Add exhaustive certificates for every accepted A2/A3 target and atom ordering showing premises can be found, retained, cited, and converted into legal sequential actions without QUERY_TYPED. Also certify byte identity across the complete pre-action model-visible goal, state, prompt input, workspace, budgets, snapshot handle, catalog behavior, return serialization, and timing class while the registered correct assignments differ.

disagreements.issue: Whether S-bind and cited-atom twin substitution are coherent causal interventions rather than semantically impossible corruptions.

positions.position: Fixed-point-free within-stratum binding permutations and type-matched twin-atom substitution, while preserving registered bins and envelopes, are sufficient causal falsifiers.

A valid intervention must globally rewrite canonical identities and all co-referent views with explicit intervention taint, and a twin-memory fork is valid only at a byte-colliding decision state or with a registered coherent public-state replacement.

resolution.rationale: Preserving counts does not preserve semantic compatibility with provenance roots, aliases, query membership, or answer slots. After swapped actions make public states diverge, memory-only twin substitution can create a state no world could produce. A changed action under such a hybrid is not evidence of authentic binding dependence.
resolution.selected_position: Require globally coherent, explicitly tainted semantic rewrites and valid matched-state twin forks.
resolution.required_change: V2 must define one global fixed-point-free semantic rewrite over canonical atom IDs, aliases, roots, forward/reverse/incident/statement views, query membership, answer slots, returns, and manifests; intervention products must be marked as control-corrupted rather than genuine SUPPORTED lifecycle truth and must pass root-compatibility audits. Define the exact byte-colliding decision cuts at which memory-only twin substitution is valid, or fork the matched twin public state while enumerating the minimal registered changed bytes and preserving all other inputs.

disagreements.issue: Whether the future confirmation and linter support an action-improvement, retention, or causal-memory statement that survives standard-baseline reversal and scientific overstatement.

positions.position: The D-LoRA and A-native superiority co-primaries, E-text non-inferiority, broad baseline roster, fixed-deck qualifiers, and forbidden-claim linter adequately delimit the future bounded claim.

Confirmation can pass while E-LoRA is harmful versus N or loses to honest context/retrieval/reflection baselines; the token-cut and decisive-old-root evidence is absent; semantic paraphrases can evade a string linter; and finite-world predictive support is not external causal truth.

resolution.rationale: Calibration selection does not protect locked confirmation against comparator reversal. The literal C03 sentence is comparator-qualified, but broader complete-pipeline, useful-memory, developmental-retention, or causal-discovery language would not be supported. Operational support under registered PCFL interventions is valuable but must not be described as independent causal truth.
resolution.selected_position: Require locked no-memory usefulness and exact comparator-qualified, fixed-deck, operational-support language.
resolution.required_change: V2 must require positive locked confirmation usefulness versus N and predeclare the allowed conclusion when E-LoRA loses to CTX-C, CTX-H, R-rec, X-text, A-common, A-native, or E-text. Bind tokenizer/renderer evidence and prove every credited target causally depends on an eligible root outside every legal non-memory/context surface. Bind a reviewed claim policy with adversarial semantic paraphrases covering scaling, growing histories, developmental retention, recurrence, continual/online learning, autonomous discovery, and external causal truth. Use only 'operationally supported PCFL relations under registered interventions' unless separately authorized external causal evidence exists.

disagreements.issue: Whether AT14 and AT16 are executable exact gates without bound degenerate-statistic conventions, golden vectors, frozen instances, and a full-suite CPU ceiling.

positions.position: Exhaustive sign flips, a studentized statistic, Romano--Wolf stepdown, grid inversion, Holm families, failure-as-zero, split counts, and a separately declared CPU budget sufficiently specify the implementation target.

The studentizer, zero-variance/all-zero behavior, tie and grid endpoint rules, bootstrap RNG, calibration power formula, instance bytes, independent golden outputs, and full CPU ceiling are missing, so implementation would choose scientific decision rules.

resolution.rationale: Deterministic zero-valued failures make degenerate vectors likely, not hypothetical. Naming a family of procedures does not uniquely determine outputs at these boundaries, and an absent 'separately declared' budget makes AT16 undecidable.
resolution.selected_position: Bind every estimator convention, instance, golden result, and CPU resource ceiling before implementation.
resolution.required_change: V2 must bind the studentizer, finite-sample denominators, zero-variance and all-zero rules, sign-flip and max-T tie ordering, stepdown convention, 1e-4 inversion domain and endpoint behavior, Holm tie handling, bootstrap RNG algorithm and exact resamples or derivation, missing/failure patterns, and the calibration power/no-claim decision formula. Include independently calculated golden vectors for every edge case and bind the exact full-suite wall-time, cores, memory, processes, energy, and exhaustion disposition.

disagreements.issue: Whether passing CPU fixtures can falsify leakage and establish causal memory use for later model, provider, native-memory, recognizer, generative, cache, tokenizer, or LoRA backends.

positions.position: D0 perturbation, simulated dispatch/isolation, scripted mask/twin traces, and synthetic binding fixtures falsify answer laundering, post-hoc trace credit, and invalid binding interventions.

D0 validates only the reference checkers and contracts; the exact later backends and live model states can introduce side channels or fail the interventions and must rerun equivalent black-box and process-level tests under new authority.

resolution.rationale: The second position is mandatory. Scripted traces and placeholder processes contain no autonomous cognition or trained substrate to which mechanism credit can attach. The future implementations most likely to introduce timing, cache, tokenization, target-conditioning, provider-recovery, and model-state effects are expressly absent from D0.
resolution.selected_position: D0 establishes reference-checker conformance only; future exact backends must reproduce the audits before any model result or credit.
resolution.required_change: V2 must narrow every D0 expected/falsifies clause to reference-contract or checker conformance. It must also register a mandatory later predecessor-bound reauthorization test for the exact text, A-MEM native/common, recognizer, generative, LoRA, tokenizer, provider, cache, and process implementations, including complete input collisions, timing/error behavior, isolation and resume, mask/twin forks on actual sealed pre-decision model states, and S-life/S-bind/T-swap outcomes. No D0 artifact may be inherited as scientific evidence for those backends.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind the exact D0 path/command/entry-point/dependency allowlist and complete CPU resource ceiling in v2 before implementation authority.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Use exactly four named one-edge views consistently in every v2 compiler, binding, catalog, resource, and test clause.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The visible accepted-item posterior, rejected-proposal exclusion, degenerate-state handling, and quantile convention are necessary to define Bayes-N uniquely.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind the exact target-conditioned posterior, rational oracle vectors, zero-mass handling, and empirical quantile rule in v2.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Hidden truth, unrestricted eligible atoms, and authentic bounded one-atom access answer different questions and cannot share one necessity claim.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Register three separate controllers and award source-lifetime usability only to the reader- and resolver-budget-constrained authentic controller.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Require a complete pre-action model-visible byte-collision and timing-class certificate for every paired target with different correct assignments.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind a global identity/view/query/root-consistent tainted S-bind rewrite and restrict twin substitution to certified colliding cuts or coherent matched-state forks.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Add locked usefulness versus N and a predeclared conclusion matrix for reversals against every strong context, retrieval, linked-memory, and text comparator.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The prose firewall is a strength, but exact token-cut/old-root evidence and semantic paraphrase rejection are absent, so the narrower retention label is not yet mechanically secured.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Degenerate statistics, tie and endpoint conventions, bootstrap derivation, calibration power logic, golden outputs, manifests, and the full CPU budget remain choices rather than ratified rules.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind all estimator edge conventions, independently calculated golden vectors, exact instances, and the full-suite resource ceiling in v2.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Synthetic fixtures validate checker behavior only and cannot discharge risks introduced by exact future model, backend, tokenizer, provider, cache, or LoRA implementations.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Narrow D0 language to checker conformance and require a newly authorized exact-backend replay of noninterference, isolation, mask/twin, and binding tests before scientific interpretation.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Chronological fits, predictions, contrasts, and root deduplication justify operational PCFL support, not causal independence, autonomous discovery, or truth outside the finite generator.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Post-implementation CPU tests and D1 review cannot substitute for prior ratification of material world, interface, controller, intervention, estimator, split, and resource choices.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Move every material design-binding gate before D0 implementation and limit D0 to implementing already ratified exact bytes.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: The absent D0 file/entry-point manifest and full CPU budget make implementation authority incomplete.
Reference fixtures cannot prove noninterference for later exact text, native, generative, recognizer, provider, cache, tokenizer, or LoRA backends.
Scripted traces and synthetic corpora validate measurement code but contain no autonomous resolver, DREAM process, or trained substrate to credit.
Schemas and actual CPU/split instances are material benchmark contracts and must precede implementation.
Only an authentic source-derived controller under the exact reader/resolver budget can support a lifetime-memory usability conclusion.
Locked confirmation must preserve usefulness versus N and explicitly constrain conclusions under context, retrieval, reflection, native, or text reversal.
Exactly four views is the coherent intended rule, but the contradiction must be repaired in new hash-bound bytes before implementation.
Actual sealed model states must undergo the registered interventions before any item or aggregate receives constructive-memory credit.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retain exact hash/scope review, but v1 does not pass its advertised exactness: v2 must include the D0 allowlist, budgets, schemas, tokenizer/renderer fixtures, and frozen instance manifests before implementation.
Retain the firewall, but run it against a pre-ratified path/command/transitive-capability allowlist and interpret it only as D0 capability conformance.
Retain the twin instrument gate, but bind the exact 64 pairs and extend its evidence to complete per-target pre-action model-visible collision rather than only source/initial collision.
Retain structural minimality and chronology, but bind the target/source instances, token cuts, and proof that every credited decisive root lies outside all legal non-memory/context surfaces.
Retain full/quotient equivalence, but first bind the accepted-visible-item posterior, rejected-proposal exclusion, degenerate states, exact rational oracles, and quantile convention.

Retain the headroom/shortcut thresholds, but separately report hidden-world solvability, eligible-atom information ceiling, and authentic source-derived one-atom-reader control; only the last bears the lifetime-usability conclusion.
Retain strict parsing and visibility enumeration, but the schemas, serialized goldens, normalization and copy-origin rules must be hash-bound inputs rather than implementation outputs.
Retain reference noninterference, but add complete target-pair collisions and exhaustive generic reachability, and require equivalent later black-box/process tests on every exact scientific backend.
Retain the strengthened lifecycle suite, but bind control-intervention taint/root compatibility and restrict its conclusion to operational support in the finite PCFL generator.
Retain the one-edge/direct-closure compiler test with exactly four views, after v2 removes every six-view conflict and binds the same count across all consumers.
Retain deterministic snapshot/runtime fixtures, but later provider/model/backend processes must rerun the exact isolation, cache, timing, error, and recovery audits before science.
Retain checker conformance, but bind valid counterfactual-state semantics and require the same forks on actual sealed model pre-decision states before constructive credit.
Retain the three distinct controls, but define one coherent global S-bind rewrite, explicit control taint, root compatibility, four-view consistency, and valid twin-state assignment semantics.

Retain pair aggregation and multiplicity structure, but bind exact manifests, every degenerate/tie/grid/bootstrap convention and golden vector, the calibration power rule, and the locked baseline-reversal decision.

Retain the unequal-resource roster and ledger, but bind its schemas and require confirmation conclusions to account for N, context, retrieval, reflection, native/common linked memory, and E-text reversals.
Retain bit-reproducibility and the simulator micro-bound, but AT16 is undecidable until v2 binds the complete full-suite CPU resource ceiling and exhaustion disposition.

Retain the claim firewall, but bind adversarial semantic paraphrases, baseline-reversal dispositions, post-working-window evidence rules, and the operational-PCFL-support qualifier rather than relying on tags or literal strings.

Retain nonpromotion and independent review, but D1 cannot cure unratified D0 design choices; a new exact v2 deliberation and human decision must precede D0, and later exact-backend evidence requires another authority chain.

questions: Whether to accept the model recommendation that v1 authorize no D0 implementation and instead request a newly hash-bound v2 containing the complete D0 allowlist/resource ceiling, schemas/golden bytes/token cuts, frozen instances, and pre-implementation gates.
Whether v2 should bind exactly four compiler views and three separate controls for hidden-world solvability, eligible-atom information, and authentic source-derived bounded reader use.

Whether every A2/A3 pair must have a complete pre-action model-visible collision and exhaustive generic-reader reachability, and whether S-bind/twin forks must obey the coherent intervention semantics specified in this rework.

Whether locked confirmation must retain positive usefulness versus no memory and use exact comparator-qualified, fixed-deck, operational-PCFL-support language with no scaling, online, recurrence, developmental, or autonomous-discovery synonym.

Whether D0 results are strictly reference-checker conformance and all exact future model/backend implementations must rerun process-level noninterference, isolation, and causal-credit tests under new authority.
